title: Patlabor the Case Files Game's 3rd Trailer Highlights 3 Primary Modes
content: Good Smile Company started streaming the third trailer for it and developer Chime Corporation 's Patlabor the Case Files , a new 3D action game based on the Patlabor franchise , on Wednesday. The new video previews the game's three primary modes: Main Mission, Another Side Mission, and Simulator Mode.
author: ANN

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Introduces Characters in New Trailer
content: Atlus revealed a trailer for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, on Tuesday introducing the characters. The remake will feature a new English voice cast. The original Persona 4 launched for PlayStation 2 in 2008.
author: ANN

content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, and Crunchyroll is all set for the debut of some of the most anticipated series of the year. However, while the Summer 2026 lineup already looks amazing, the wait for new episodes each week can be quite daunting.

title: Akiko Okuda's 'Rusuban' Short Manga Inspires Short Anime Film on August 1
content: Kenji Iwaisawa 's ROCK'N ROLL MOUNTAIN ( 100 Meters , ON-GAKU: Our Sound ) animation studio announced on Thursday that it is producing a short anime adaptation of Akiko Okuda 's "Rusuban" (House-Sitting) short manga.
author: ANN

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game Moves Release Date Forward to September 4
content: CAPCOM revealed on the official X/Twitter account for its Onimusha : Way of the Sword game on Thursday it will now release the game three weeks earlier on September 4. The game was previously slated to launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam, and Switch on September 25.
author: ANN

title: Witch and Hound TV Anime Announced, Original Author Joins Series Composition
content: Rainy Kamitsuki dark fantasy light novel Witch and Hound is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The announcement included the release of the first teaser trailer, teaser visual, and main staff details. The anime will be directed by Takanori Tsujimoto, with Kengo Saito handling character designs.
author: Anime Corner

title: Short Story 'Rusuban' Gets Short Anime Movie for August 2026
content: Animation studio Rock'n Roll Mountain announced a short anime movie adaptation of Akiko Okuda 's Rusuban ( Babysitting ) short manga story on Thursday, revealing the cast, staff, a visual (pictured), and a trailer.

title: Yoshitaka Amano's Original Anime 'Zan' in Production
content: Yoshitaka Amano 's newest company, Yoshitaka Amano Inc., announced on Thursday that the previously announced Zan anime project is in production and revealed the main staff. The pilot will be shown at the Anime Expo 2026 convention on July 3.
